note: Source list for the bots. Run "node tools/build-bots.js" (the GitHub workflow does it for you) to bundle these files into bots-data.js. This folder is not published.

bots.name: ITC Differs Smart Cycle
bots.description: Trades Differs. Each contract picks a new random digit 0–9 and wins if the last digit is anything else.

bots.name: ITC Under Shield
bots.description: Trades Under with a random 7, 8 or 9. After a loss it switches to recovery Under 6 until it wins.

bots.name: ITC Over Shield
bots.description: Trades Over with a random 0, 1 or 2. After a loss it switches to recovery Over 4 until it wins.

bots.name: ITC Over Recovery Sniper
bots.description: Trades Over 2. After a loss it waits until the last 3 digits are all above 4, then trades recovery Over 4, and checks again after every recovery loss.

bots.name: Signal Autobot Even Odd
bots.description: Fast 1-tick bot. Waits for 3 odd digits then an even digit and trades Even (set Side to Odd for the reverse). Has take profit, stop loss and martingale.

bots.name: ITC Phoenix
bots.description: Starts on Over 1 with take profit, stop loss and martingale. Change the market, contract or digit in the first blocks, or use the quick settings.

bots.name: ITC Over 1 Recovery 3
bots.description: Trades Over 1. The moment it loses, it switches to recovery Over 3, then goes back to Over 1 after a win. No conditions.

bots.name: ITC Under 8 Recovery 7
bots.description: Trades Under 8. The moment it loses, it switches to recovery Under 7, then goes back to Under 8 after a win. No conditions.

bots.name: ITC Even Odd Bot
bots.description: Trades Even by default. Press run and it trades straight away. Switch to Odd with the quick setting or in the first blocks.

bots.name: ITC Entry Digit Bot
bots.description: Pick your entry digit in Trade parameters. The moment that digit appears, the bot starts trading (Over or Under) and keeps trading every tick until take profit, stop loss or the run limit.

bots.name: ITC Bulk Trader Bot
bots.description: Bulk trading bot. Trades Over 1 by default, or any market type you choose. Switch bulk trading on or off and set the number of bulk trades (default 3) in Trade parameters. Take profit, stop loss, martingale and number of runs all apply.
